title: OEM Siemens Energy Motor for T-AO Vessel
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSUP.NAVSUP GLOBAL LOGISTICS SUPPORT.NAVSUP FLC PUGET SOUND.NAVSUP FLT LOG CTR PUGET SOUND
description_text: NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center Puget Sound intends to solicit and award a firm-fixed-price Supply-type Purchase Order for a BRAND NAME OEM Siemens Energy and Automation Inc. motor as total small business set-aside. See attached solicitation and redacted Brand Name Justification posted 31 MAR 2026 for requirements. All responses shall be submitted prior to solicitation closing date on page 1, box 8.
